title: US on alert as Iran's plan to target Americans abroad in 'advanced stages': Report
summary_full: Amid escalating violence in the region, the United States is curtailing its embassy staff levels in Jordan, Lebanon, Qatar, and the United Arab Emirates. This step follows alarming threats from Iran towards U.S. personnel and Houthi assaults on Saudi territory, prompting the evacuation of non-essential personnel and their families from Saudi Arabia.
